2) Move the live demo to 4:00pm PT and keep it interactive. I have a conflict at 4:30pm, so we'd aim for 4:00–4:50. If that works for your team, I can resend the calendar invite.

Which do you prefer? I copied Marissa (solutions engineer) to hold both blocks on our side while we confirm. If you want, I can also prepare a focused 20-minute integration deep-dive as an add-on after the main session.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
